scope: Aggregate reporting rule only. It contains no source rows, identities, source locators, or protected metadata.

denominator_rule.team_complete_when: Included source-backed exposure hours are at least the accepted fixture-derived match hours for that team's active 2025-26 build.
denominator_rule.team_incomplete_when: Included source-backed exposure is absent or falls below that fixture-derived match-hours floor.
denominator_rule.team_incomplete_output: Keep injury counts and severity. Set coverage hours, training hours, distance, incidence and burden values and denominators to JSON null. Keep fixture-derived match hours. Do not impute exposure.
denominator_rule.team_complete_output: Keep actual source-backed values and rates. State that submitted exposure may still be incomplete and that no imputation occurred.
denominator_rule.league_output: Keep injury counts, severity and fixture-derived match hours. Set league exposure hours, training hours, distance, incidence and burden values and denominators to JSON null unless all 16 team denominators are complete.

monthly_rule: A monthly incidence or burden rate is JSON null when that team-month lacks source-backed included exposure. A league monthly rate is JSON null unless all 16 active teams have a source-backed denominator for that month and all team denominators are complete.
grain_rule: Use the sole curated exposure grain across the active build even when all rows are excluded. Use the public value unknown when that metadata is absent or mixed.

compatibility.year1: The 2024-25 views, tuples, payloads and releases are untouched.
